object.definition: An unknown real symmetric positive definite $d\times d$ matrix, with spectrum in public $[\mu,\beta]$ and $\beta/\mu\le\kappa$. The matrix $\log A$ may be indefinite.

assumption.description: A is positive definite with spectrum in the public interval [mu,beta] and kappa(A)<=kappa.

norm.definition: Use the Euclidean vector norm $\|z\|_2=(\sum_i|z_i|^2)^{1/2}$ and the matrix operator norm $\|M\|_{\rm op}=\max_{\|z\|_2=1}\|Mz\|_2$.
